label: Orders
caption: MARLOWE, CHRISTOPHER V. LEBLANC, SEC., LA DOC, ET AL.
text: The application to vacate stay presented to Justice Alito and by him referred to the Court is denied. Nothing in this order should be construed to preclude applicant from filing a grievance setting out specifically the relief he requests be provided to him in the prison, and in the event that such request is filed, it should be decided promptly.
